scenario: An independent recruiter evaluates Talent Signal from the public homepage, directly changes one exact evidence clause, follows the dependent state and next move, and navigates to a useful public destination without granting external execution authority.
frozen_evidence: Playwright production drag at 1440x1100: remote-flexibility aria-pressed changed to false; scope changed from 4/4 to 3/4; Work mode changed to No supported change; dependency changed to Ask what must be true; released transform returned to the identity matrix.

Playwright reduced-motion production run: the phrase remained at the identity matrix during pointer travel, the instruction became Select one marked phrase, and the console reported zero errors or warnings.
Responsive inspection at 320, 390, 820, 821, 900, 1024, 1040, 1041, 1280, and 1440 pixels reported zero horizontal overflow; the 1040/1041 navigation breakpoint changed cleanly.
Mobile navigation proof: main and footer became inert, body scroll locked, Escape closed the menu, and focus returned to Open navigation; at 320 pixels the internal menu scrolled to Request access.

Canonical production build sitemap: HTTP 200, Content-Type application/xml, eight canonical https://gettalentsignal.com URLs, eight unique loc elements, valid lastmod values, and zero priority or changefreq elements.
Clean worktree gates: web lint passed; TypeScript passed; 12 Vitest files and 46 tests passed; Next production build generated 17 routes; documentation, wiki, and architecture checks passed.
Final native interaction bundle comparison: script transfer fell from 213659 to 169176 bytes and unused JavaScript fell from 59127 to 29416 bytes compared with the same clean Motion build.

Lighthouse 13.4.1: accessibility 100, best practices 100, SEO 100, CLS 0; stable clean run scored performance 92 before the native runtime reduction. Later timing scores were excluded as a release gate because host WindowServer and VM processes sustained high concurrent CPU load.

review_plan.reason: The public artifact must make one recruiter job and result obvious before category claims.
The artifact turns sensitive conversation evidence into proposed state and action.
The public site and direct manipulation must remain complete across responsive, keyboard, and motion-preference states.
Recruiter-facing momentum language can create candidate pressure or hidden judgment.
The marketing surface must not turn work attention into a candidate score.
The panel must explicitly decide whether sourcing claims or coverage evidence exist.
Granola and recruiting-AI references need current source discipline and falsifiable implications.
The panel must prevent relationship momentum from being presented as job performance fit.
The executive-search context requires an explicit decision about person-level potential evidence.
The sample contains candidate-owned timing and work-condition evidence.

reviews.lens: independent recruiter task completion, decision usefulness, and operating clarity
strengths: The first viewport names the audience, input, and safe next-move result, then proves the complete evidence-to-dependency loop.

reviews.lens: evidence integrity, provenance, privacy, authorization, and reversible action
strengths: Direct manipulation changes scope while the clause returns to its source; fact confirmation and external action remain separate.

reviews.lens: responsive task completion, hierarchy, accessibility, motion, and recovery
strengths: All tested widths avoid horizontal overflow, and pointer, click, keyboard, menu recovery, dark mode, and reduced motion remain complete.

reviews.lens: candidate dignity, transparency, proportionality, and humane follow-through
strengths: Unknowns remain unknown, the client-side policy owner receives the next task, and the candidate is not pressured or silently judged.

reviews.lens: job relevance, construct discipline, decision claims, and responsible evaluation
strengths: The artifact evaluates operational evidence and explicitly rejects fit, quality, personality, potential, engagement, and acceptance scores.

reviews.lens: search strategy, hidden-talent recall, query diversity, and sourcing coverage
strengths: The artifact correctly makes no sourcing, matching, profile-completeness, or discovery claim.
missing_evidence: No sourcing query, result set, talent map, or recall benchmark is part of this artifact.

reviews.lens: current recruiting signals, source quality, counterevidence, and falsifiable product implications
strengths: Current Granola, LinkedIn, WEF, and AESC sources inform bounded mechanisms without being presented as Talent Signal market proof.

reviews.lens: role outcomes, performance evidence, process usefulness, and win-win decision quality
strengths: The artifact makes no performance-fit claim and treats the next move as resolving one decision uncertainty.
missing_evidence: No role scorecard, performance outcomes, comparable accomplishments, or candidate-owned success criteria are present.

reviews.lens: longitudinal potential evidence, readiness, traits, and uncertainty discipline
strengths: The artifact makes no trait, readiness, leadership-capacity, or future-potential inference from one conversation.
missing_evidence: No longitudinal behavior, repeated observation, structured reference, or role-transition evidence is present.

reviews.lens: candidate-owned decision conditions, motivation evidence, momentum, and close-risk discipline
strengths: Candidate-owned timing and remote conditions remain revisable evidence, and no close probability or pressure script is generated.

top_findings.reason: The drag interaction changes only proposal scope and every dependent state retracts with its evidence.
top_findings.next_step: Preserve the source-return and separate-approval contract in future interaction changes.
top_findings.verification: Pointer, click, and Enter must continue to produce the same 3-of-4 state with zero external mutation.

top_findings.reason: The redesigned navigation and evidence loop remain complete from 320 to 1440 pixels with no overflow.
top_findings.next_step: Keep 320, 390, 1040, and 1041 pixels in the visual regression matrix.
top_findings.verification: Each width preserves source-first order, reachable actions, Escape recovery, and zero horizontal overflow.

top_findings.reason: The hero now identifies the executive-search audience, source conversation, verified context, and smallest next move.
top_findings.next_step: Measure comprehension with the intended independent-recruiter audience.
top_findings.verification: At least four of five recruiters can state the input, output, and human authority boundary without prompting.

agreements: All applicable reviewers agree that the page demonstrates work-attention intelligence without ranking a person.
All safety-relevant reviewers agree that confirming state grants no execution authority.
All workflow-relevant reviewers agree that the direct manipulation is causal product proof rather than decorative motion.
The three abstentions are correct scope decisions, not missing release reviews.

disagreements.issue: Whether an executive-search homepage should receive person-level performance, sourcing, or potential scores.

positions.position: The artifact is complete for its operational relationship-momentum job.
positions.evidence: The first viewport demonstrates source evidence, a reviewed change, a dependency, and a safe next move.

positions.position: The artifact cannot support a potential judgment.
positions.evidence: No longitudinal behavior, role transitions, or structured follow-up evidence is present.

positions.position: The artifact cannot support a sourcing-coverage judgment.
positions.evidence: No query, candidate set, recall benchmark, or talent map is present.

disagreements.resolution: Pass the operational homepage while preserving explicit abstentions for person-level and sourcing constructs.
disagreements.resolution_basis: Scientific abstention keeps the product boundary honest and prevents a complete relationship workflow from becoming an unsupported person score.

adjudication.rationale: Every applicable specialist scored the artifact 4 of 4, all contract validators pass, three out-of-scope lenses abstained with explicit evidence requirements, and no veto remains. Real production interaction, responsive recovery, canonical sitemap output, automated tests, and a clean build all match the declared boundary.

next_tests.test: Run a five-second comprehension and one-conversation task with five independent recruiters.
next_tests.evidence_required: Recorded first interpretation, task completion, corrections, and post-task explanation of the authority boundary.
next_tests.pass_condition: At least four of five state the input, verified output, safe next move, and separate external-action approval without prompting.

next_tests.test: Run Lighthouse 13.4.1 in a quiet CI or preview environment after deployment.
next_tests.evidence_required: Mobile Lighthouse JSON with host utilization recorded and the final native interaction bundle.
next_tests.pass_condition: Performance at least 90, accessibility 100, best practices 100, SEO 100, CLS 0, and no increase above 169176 transferred script bytes.

next_tests.test: Inspect the deployed sitemap and submit or refresh it in the authorized search-console property.
next_tests.evidence_required: Production response headers, parsed canonical URL set, and search-console processing result.
next_tests.pass_condition: Eight unique canonical public URLs are accepted with no format, host, duplicate, or lastmod warning.
